headlines.description: — Tyrese Maxey scored 40 points, including the winning layup with 1.3 seconds remaining, Joel Embiid had 37 points and the Philadelphia 76ers rallied to edge the Sacramento Kings 113-111 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Maxey scores 40 points and hits winning layup with 1.3 seconds left to lead 76ers over Kings 113-111

headlines.description: — Kyshawn George scored 23 points, Alex Sarr added 16 points and 17 rebounds, and the Washington Wizards beat the short-handed Milwaukee Bucks 109-99 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: George, Sarr help Wizards outlast Bucks, playing without Antetokounmpo, 109-99

headlines.description: — Kevin Durant scored 31 points and the Houston Rockets beat short-handed Atlanta 104-86 on Thursday night, ending the Hawks' four-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Durant scores 31 points as Rockets dominate second half and roll past short-handed Hawks 104-86

headlines.description: — Norman Powell scored 21 points, Bam Adebayo had 20 points and 12 rebounds and the Miami Heat held on for a 116-113 victory over the Chicago Bulls on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Powell scores 21 points and Heat outlast Bulls for 116-113 win

headlines.description: — Kon Knueppel made two free throws with 4.1 seconds left for a career-high 34 points and the Charlotte Hornets beat the Dallas Mavericks 123-121 on Thursday night, spoiling Duke roommate Cooper Flagg's 49-point game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hornets edge Mavericks 123-121 to spoil Cooper Flagg's 49-point game

headlines.description: — Jamal Murray scored nine of his 27 points in the final 2:26, and the Nuggets spoiled Michael Porter Jr.'s return to Denver with a 107-103 win over the Brooklyn Nets on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murray scores 27, Nuggets beat Nets 107-103 in Porter's return to Denver

headlines.description: — Dillon Brooks scored a career-high 40 points, Grayson Allen added 24 and the Phoenix Suns beat the Eastern Conference-leading Detroit Pistons 114-96 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dillon Brooks scores career-high 40 on his own T-shirt night, leading Suns past Pistons 114-96

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Minnesota Timberwolves

headlines.description: — Anthony Edwards scored 26 points and the Minnesota Timberwolves matched a season high with 22 3-pointers in a 123-111 win over the Oklahoma City Thunder on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Timberwolves hit 22 3-pointers, coast to 123-111 win over Thunder
